description: FROZEN M2 rule-boundary examples (A-owned). Shapes per 02-contract.md and the frozen phase map. C may ADD executable examples but must not change frozen shapes without Claude approval. Shapes freeze only after A+C sign-off and Claude approval.

rule_result_example._comment: income phase, player account only; child accounts follow in later items of the same phase (see multi_account_example). Amounts are REAL values from C's annual_income_quote(30000, has_job=True, job_hours=40, retention=0.6): tax per SALARY_TAX_BRACKETS; net = gross - tax - expenses by construction. Continuation points at the NEXT phase (education) with item_cursor 0.

events.text: You earned $30,000 before tax this year.

rule_result_example._money_note: amounts ILLUSTRATIVE until C's annual_income_quote lands with real tax brackets; executable fixture must assert gross - tax - expenses == net exactly

multi_account_example._comment: income phase with TWO accounts: player and working child. Child income posts to the CHILD's account, not the household. Posting keys differ by account_id, so no collision.

events.text: Your child Kit earned $4,800 this year.

interrupted_after_one_account_example._comment: income phase posted the player account, then the command failed/restarted. The persisted cursor resumes at item_cursor 1 (the child); the player posting is NOT repeated because its source_key is already posted.
interrupted_after_one_account_example.retry_behavior: re-enter income phase at item_cursor 1; idempotent keys return original rows; no double credit

pending_choice_example._comment: family_events phase offers a divorce choice; continuation points AFTER the current event via item_cursor. Two choices in one phase and per-entity markers prevent rerunning.

pending_decision.title: Divorce
pending_decision.text: Your partner wants a divorce. What will you do?

two_choices_one_phase_example._comment: family_events with a divorce (person A) then a child event (person B). Each stores its own sampled outcome and its own continuation; resolving the first resumes at the second, resolving the second resumes after the phase.

terminal_transition_example._comment: a fatal effect ends the turn immediately: only close phases run afterward

events.text: You died due to complications of cancer.

action_input_example._comment: costs/eligibility from parity-matrix row 66: admission at age 17, NO application fee

naming_decision_example._comment: birth naming: pending choice with a bounded text input; private sampled data stays server-side

context_example.note: Duck-typed fields C reads; built by A's src/game context factory. Never import GameService from rule code.
